nodes.label: Phase Boundary Verification
nodes.rationale: Verification fires at each phase boundary (Ideation to Inception, Inception to Construction, Construction to Operation), on demand, and as a lightweight stage-completion self-check, because gaps between phases are invisible to per-stage checking: each boundary check asks whether the downstream artifacts actually consume the upstream ones.

nodes.label: Traceability Matrix
nodes.rationale: Maps Intent to Requirement to Story to Architecture Component to Code Module to Test Suite, with three status indicators (fully traced, partially traced, orphan) so a broken chain is named at a specific link rather than reported as a global percentage.

nodes.label: Phase Check Report
nodes.rationale: Written per boundary as verification/phase-check-<phase>.md carrying coverage percentages, warnings, consistency checks and a human approval checkbox, so the verdict is a reviewable artifact and the human, not the tool, accepts the boundary.

nodes.label: PHASE_VERIFIED Audit Event
nodes.rationale: Recorded by the engine into the active record's audit/<host>-<clone-id>.md shard and explicitly never appended by hand, keeping the audit trail tool-owned so a prose-written receipt cannot claim a verification that never ran.
